purpose: Provenance of the admin broadcast (AdminMessagePacket, AdminBroadcastManager, console 'announce'/'announcemap', chat '.announce'/'.announcemap') and the operator's shutdown countdown (ShutdownCountdown, console 'shutdown'). ShutdownBroadcastTests reproduces the client contract and every countdown value below from the implementation.

handler.locator: client/communicator.pyo Recv_AdminMessage(msg, filterId), source line 1046, offsets 0-74: msg = _textfilter.FilterText(msg); gmMsgHeader = BuildModuleText('uielementlanguage', _uielement.ID_CHAT_MESSAGE_HEADER_GM); PostEvent(UI_DISPLAY_CLIENT_MESSAGE, None, gmMsgHeader + msg, filterId)

admin_message.entity: the communicator system entity (the same module as Recv_SystemMessage, line 1052; SysEntity.CommunicatorId = 8 in the emulator)
arguments: msg: text (sent as a Python unicode string; it is concatenated with the unicode header)

filter_choice.reasoning: The filter is the server's argument. Only SYSTEM_GM is given Chat_Yellow by default and the default General tab subscribes to it (client/clientmessagesettings.pyo FillInDefaultColors line 185, CreateDefaultTabs line 100); SYSTEM_GENERAL is Chat_White (line 184). Both videos show the admin lines yellow in the General tab, next to the white SYSTEM_GENERAL line 'You may not issue a command at this time.' (fxAtDpxypSw t=5).

payload_is_server_text.reasoning: The German client shows 'ADMIN-NACHRICHT: ALERT: PLATEAU IS LOST!' and 'ADMIN-NACHRICHT: Server Shutting Down in 10...': a localized client header before an English payload.

admin_message.client_send_path: The final client has no way to send one. communicator.SendAdminChat (line 380) calls SendCallUserMethod(chatdata.chatIDToMethodName[SYSTEM], ...), and chatIDToMethodName[8] is None (generated/client/chatdata.pyo offsets 349-352); nothing calls SendAdminChat, and slashcommand.pyo defines no admin or broadcast command. Live staff therefore sent these from outside the player client; the emulator's console and dot commands stand in for that tool, which is not in any artifact (GAP-SHUTDOWN-ADMIN-TOOL).

dialog_text.english: You have been disconnected from the server
dialog_text.german: Ihre Verbindung zum Server wurde getrennt.

chain.locator: engine calls the current input state's GameOnDisconnect when the game-server connection ends
client/inputstate/game.pyo GameOnDisconnect line 66: drops the network-stats method call, then _exitgame.GameOnDisconnect() (offsets 39-45)

client/inputstate/exitgame.pyo GameOnDisconnect line 109: if not g_requestedRestart, client.inputhandlers.GameOnDisconnect() (offsets 0-16); then _ClearCharacterCache() (line 116), which calls _communicator.ClearChatInfo() (line 128)

client/inputhandlers.pyo GameOnDisconnect line 102 -> OnDisconnect line 83: SaveCharacterData; message box 'Disconnected', SetModal(True), prompt BuildUIElement(ID_DISCONNECTED), one button ID_OK bound to 'enter' -> OnDisconnectOK (line 95: back to the login input state)

disconnect.requested_restart: exitgame.g_requestedRestart becomes True only in OnLogout (line 80, offset 0-3); a close the player did not ask for always takes the dialog branch. Character selection has the same branch (client/inputstate/characterselection.pyo GameOnDisconnect line 126).

matches_footage.reasoning: Both recordings: the chat window empties (ClearChatInfo) and a modal 'You have been disconnected from the server' / 'Ihre Verbindung zum Server wurde getrennt.' with Ok appears over the still-rendered world; no fade, cinematic or other message first.

disconnect.server_side: Client.Close -> LengthedSocket.Close: Socket.Shutdown(Both) then Close, an orderly end of stream with nothing sent first. ShutdownBroadcastTests checks the peer reads end-of-stream.

zone_loss_alert.implemented_as: free text only: an operator can send it with 'announce'. No rule sends it (GAP-SHUTDOWN-ZONE-LOSS-RULE).

first_line_format.note: Only 10 was ever observed. A uniform countdown from another number uses the same words with its own number (operator's choice, not evidence).

text.reasoning_note: _gwh1__XecI (1080p source) reads 'Server Shutting Down in 10...'; fxAtDpxypSw (480p) reads the same words with the trailing punctuation unresolved ('10.'). The 1080p reading is taken.

corroboration.reading: relative to its own disconnect at t=584.9: '10...' -38.9, '9' -31.9, '8' -27.9, '7' -24.9, '6' <= -20.9, '4' -14.9, '2' -5.9 s (each +-1 s); fxAtDpxypSw gives -37.1, -31.1, -27.1, -24.1, -21.1, -14.1, -6.1 s. Every step agrees within the two readings' combined sampling error.

countdown.manual_or_scripted: unknown: the irregular 3-7 s steps read like typing, but nothing shows how they were sent (GAP-SHUTDOWN-CADENCE-ORIGIN). The observed cadence is the default because it is what players saw, and a uniform one is available.
countdown.operator_only: Only the console command 'shutdown start' starts it. It has no timer, date, player-count or event trigger, and no chat command reaches it.

after_shutdown.observed: fxAtDpxypSw t=170-186: authentication still worked and all four servers (Cassiopeia US West, Centaurus EU, Hydra US East, Orion US West) were listed OFFLINE.
after_shutdown.implemented_as: by default the process stops as 'exit' does, after every disconnected client has been removed (saved) or 30 s; 'stay' keeps it running (OD-122).
